import sys
import numpy as np

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    n = int(data[0]); q = int(data[1])
    arr = np.array(data[2:2+2*q], dtype=np.int64).reshape(q, 2)
    P = arr[:, 0].copy()
    V = arr[:, 1].copy()
    MOD = 998244353

    up = np.zeros(q, dtype=bool)    # has neighbour with larger P
    down = np.zeros(q, dtype=bool)  # has neighbour with smaller P
    deg = np.zeros(q, dtype=bool)

    for k in range(q):
        if k + 1 >= q:
            break
        mask = V[k+1:] < V[k]
        if not mask.any():
            continue
        sub = np.nonzero(mask)[0] + (k + 1)
        pj = P[sub]
        pk = P[k]
        if (pj == pk).any():
            print(0)
            return
        deg[k] = True
        deg[sub] = True
        if (pj > pk).any():
            up[k] = True
        if (pj < pk).any():
            down[k] = True
        # for endpoint j (the later index): neighbour k has P_k
        # if P_j < P_k then j must be A-side (has up); else j has down
        up[sub[pj < pk]] = True
        down[sub[pj > pk]] = True

    if (up & down).any():
        print(0)
        return

    isolated = int((~deg).sum())
    print(pow(2, isolated, MOD))

import numpy as np

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    MOD = 998244353
    N = int(data[0]); Q = int(data[1])
    arr = np.array(data[2:2 + 2 * Q], dtype=np.int64)
    P = arr[0::2].copy()
    V = arr[1::2].copy()
    forced = np.zeros(Q, dtype=np.int64)  # bit1 (1) = L (prefix), bit2 (2) = R (suffix)
    for i in range(1, Q):
        Vi = V[i]
        ks = np.nonzero(V[:i] > Vi)[0]
        if ks.size == 0:
            continue
        pk = P[ks]
        pi = P[i]
        if (pk == pi).any():
            print(0)
            return
        less = pk < pi
        greater = ~less
        forced[ks[less]] |= 1
        forced[ks[greater]] |= 2
        if less.any():
            forced[i] |= 2
        if greater.any():
            forced[i] |= 1
    if (forced == 3).any():
        print(0)
        return
    free = int(np.count_nonzero(forced == 0))
    print(pow(2, free, MOD))

import sys
import numpy as np

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    n = int(data[0]); q = int(data[1])
    P = np.array([int(data[2+2*i]) for i in range(q)], dtype=np.int64)
    V = np.array([int(data[3+2*i]) for i in range(q)], dtype=np.int64)
    MOD = 998244353

    flagS = np.zeros(q, dtype=bool)  # has a neighbour with smaller P -> must be R
    flagL = np.zeros(q, dtype=bool)  # has a neighbour with larger P -> must be L
    deg = np.zeros(q, dtype=np.int64)

    for i in range(q - 1):
        m = V[i] > V[i+1:]
        if not m.any():
            continue
        pi = P[i]
        pk = P[i+1:]
        eq = m & (pk == pi)
        if eq.any():
            print(0)
            return
        lt = m & (pi < pk)   # i is smaller-P endpoint -> i is L, k is R
        gt = m & (pi > pk)   # i is larger-P endpoint -> i is R, k is L
        if lt.any():
            flagL[i] = True
            flagS[i+1:] |= lt
        if gt.any():
            flagS[i] = True
            flagL[i+1:] |= gt
        deg[i] += int(m.sum())
        deg[i+1:] += m.astype(np.int64)

    if np.any(flagS & flagL):
        print(0)
        return

    isolated = int(np.sum(~(flagS | flagL)))
    print(pow(2, isolated, MOD))

        vi = V[i]; pi = P[i]
        lower = V[i+1:] < vi
        upper = V[:i] > vi
        others = np.concatenate((P[i+1:][lower], P[:i][upper]))
        if others.size == 0:
            free += 1
            continue
        if np.any(others == pi):
            print(0)
            return
        b = others > pi
        if b.any() and not b.all():
            print(0)
            return
    print(pow(2, free, MOD))

import sys
import numpy as np

def main():
    MOD = 998244353
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    N = int(data[0]); Q = int(data[1])
    P = np.zeros(Q, dtype=np.int64)
    V = np.zeros(Q, dtype=np.int64)
    for i in range(Q):
        P[i] = int(data[2 + 2 * i])
        V[i] = int(data[3 + 2 * i])
    idx = np.arange(Q)

    def nbrs(u):
        vu = V[u]
        mask = ((idx < u) & (V > vu)) | ((idx > u) & (V < vu))
        return np.nonzero(mask)[0]

    color = np.full(Q, -1, dtype=np.int64)
    comp = np.full(Q, -1, dtype=np.int64)
    comps = 0
    isolated = 0
    for s in range(Q):
        if color[s] != -1:
            continue
        color[s] = 0
        comp[s] = comps
        stack = [s]
        hasedge = False
        while stack:
            u = stack.pop()
            nb = nbrs(u)
            if len(nb) > 0:
                hasedge = True
            cu = int(color[u])
            for v in nb.tolist():
                if color[v] == -1:
                    color[v] = 1 - cu
                    comp[v] = comps
                    stack.append(v)
                elif color[v] == cu:
                    print(0)
                    return
        if not hasedge:
            isolated += 1
        comps += 1

    ct = np.zeros(comps, dtype=bool)
    cf = np.zeros(comps, dtype=bool)
    for u in range(Q):
        vs = nbrs(u)
        if len(vs) == 0:
            continue
        if np.any(P[vs] == P[u]):
            print(0)
            return
        if np.any(color[vs] == color[u]):
            print(0)
            return
        if color[u] == 0:
            sflag = P[u] < P[vs]
        else:
            sflag = P[vs] < P[u]
        c = int(comp[u])
        if np.any(sflag):
            ct[c] = True
        if np.any(~sflag):
            cf[c] = True

    if np.any(ct & cf):
        print(0)
        return

    print(pow(2, isolated, MOD))

import sys
import numpy as np

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    MOD = 998244353
    N = int(data[0]); Q = int(data[1])
    arr = np.array(data[2:2+2*Q], dtype=np.int64).reshape(Q, 2)
    P = arr[:, 0].copy()
    V = arr[:, 1].copy()

    inv = V[:, None] > V[None, :]
    inv = np.triu(inv, 1)  # inv[a,b]: a<b and V_a > V_b
    E = inv | inv.T

    color = np.full(Q, -1, dtype=np.int64)
    ans = 1
    for s in range(Q):
        if color[s] != -1:
            continue
        color[s] = 0
        comp = [s]
        queue = [s]
        qi = 0
        while qi < len(queue):
            u = queue[qi]; qi += 1
            nb = np.nonzero(E[u])[0]
            if nb.size == 0:
                continue
            if np.any(color[nb] == color[u]):
                print(0)
                return
            un = nb[color[nb] == -1]
            if un.size > 0:
                color[un] = 1 - color[u]
                lst = un.tolist()
                queue.extend(lst)
                comp.extend(lst)
        comp_arr = np.array(comp, dtype=np.int64)
        c0 = comp_arr[color[comp_arr] == 0]
        c1 = comp_arr[color[comp_arr] == 1]
        if c0.size == 0 or c1.size == 0:
            # singleton component: no edges, 2 choices
            ans = ans * 2 % MOD
            continue
        sub = E[np.ix_(c0, c1)]
        Pa = P[c0][:, None]
        Pb = P[c1][None, :]
        valid1 = not np.any(sub & ~(Pa < Pb))
        valid2 = not np.any(sub & ~(Pa > Pb))
        cnt = int(valid1) + int(valid2)
        ans = ans * cnt % MOD
        if cnt == 0:
            print(0)
            return
    print(ans % MOD)
